# CWT fixtures

These deterministic CWT fixtures exercise Rust parser, schema, completion, project-index, navigation, and validation contracts. Keep fixtures small, UTF-8, and independent from machine-local game data.

这些确定性 CWT fixture 用于 Rust parser、schema、补全、项目索引、导航与验证契约。Fixture 应保持精简、UTF-8，并且不依赖本机游戏数据。
